evidence: log "Patched World: 1 entity tick dispatch site(s)"; 60s run clean

rationale: call-site replace checkcast+invokeinterface with callTileEntityTick(te,world); fallback path casts back to ITickable
evidence: compileJava green; runServer boots, "1 TE tick dispatch site(s)", clean until an unrelated macOS eawt quit event killed the JVM

decision: env parallel hook: WorldServer.updateBlocks per-chunk loop body extracted via ASM into synthetic mcmt$tickEnvChunk(Chunk,IZZ)V; loop dispatches callEnvTick(WorldServer,Chunk,izz) with ChunkLock radius-1
rationale: per-chunk granularity matches 1.16 envparallel; profiler calls redirected to profSection/profEnd no-ops (shared stack not thread-safe); stale FrameNodes dropped, COMPUTE_FRAMES writer with LaunchClassLoader-aware getCommonSuperClass
evidence: runServer boots Done (1.3s), all four patch logs, 4min soak zero exceptions

decision: stats command wiring: /mcmt stats shows pool size, in-flight worlds/ents/tes/envs, avg tick ms; tick-time recording moved to preTick await; dead postTick deleted
rationale: tick timing must live where the await happens now
evidence: compileJava green; runServer 115s+ clean (preTick runs every tick)

rationale: populateCrashReport string verified standalone; hook application verified via patch log; full crash path not force-triggered

rationale: stdin pipe works once per launch (cat EOF after first write)
